responsibility: Defines the user-visible and internal target options for the S/390 backend, including ABI mode, architecture/tuning selection, vector and HTM enablement, stack and hotpatch controls, branch-hardening modes, profiling options, and target variables stored in gcc_options/cl_target_option. It is the declarative option table from which GCC generates parsing, state storage, and help text for System z target switches.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name s390 files, this is the declarative target-option definition file: it names switches such as -march, -mtune, -mvx, and indirect-branch controls and specifies their generated storage variables. Unlike s390.cc it does not implement behavior, unlike s390.h it does not define backend macros/structures, and unlike s390.md it does not define instruction patterns.
